description: Ministry of Public Administration, Local Government and Democratic Governance - Minute of Sri Lanka Technological Service that comes into effect from 01.06.2013
reasoning: This gazette content details the service minute (regulations) for the Sri Lanka Technological Service, including recruitment methods, salary scales, qualifications, and service structure. It is specifically related to public sector service conditions, recruitment, and administration under the authority of the Public Service Commission, making it a clear example of a Public Service Gazette.
